name: What is the purpose of a stone retaining wall?
description: A stone retaining wall holds back soil, prevents erosion on slopes, and creates usable land, while also adding aesthetic value to a landscape.

mainEntity.name: What is the purpose of a stone retaining wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: A stone retaining wall is a structural element designed to hold back soil and prevent erosion on sloped terrain. It helps create flat, usable land, manages water runoff, and can add significant aesthetic value to a landscape. Beyond erosion control, these walls can define outdoor spaces, create garden beds, or level areas for patios and walkways. Proper construction is essential to ensure long-term stability and effectiveness, accommodating soil pressure and drainage requirements.
